connector.name: Healthcare Fda Intelligence MCP
connector.registryDescription: Scrape the FAA Aircraft Registry by N-number - aircraft make, model, year, owner name, address, airw
connector.summary: Hosted at nexgendata--healthcare-fda-intelligence-mcp.apify.actor over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.thenextgennexus. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
